title: seneciodes
intro: Seneciodes, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy or poppy bush, is a flowering plant native to Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, thanks to its health benefits of reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Seneciodes are attributed to its ability to interact with GABA receptors in the brain, producing sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of Seneciodes include alkaloids such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
